messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High 5xx rate detected in gateway-prod (us-west-2). 504 spikes from 17:04 UTC affecting /v1/generate and /v1/chat endpoints. Alert: gateway.5xx.spike severity=P2. Threshold breached: 5xx > 2.5% over 5m.

tara (oncall): I’m on it. Looks like multiple customers reporting timeouts in status too. Giving initial triage.

kevin (eng-runtime): grabbing logs now. Any indication if backend model pools saturated or this is ingress timeouts?

ashley (eng-sre): seeing a surge of downstream timeouts in envoy logs, a lot of ECONNRESET and 504 from model-proxy pods. but traces are sparse for these requests — sampling low and many missing request-id headers.

jonah (observability): confirmed — trace sampling for /v1/generate is 0.5% in prod. Also seeing logs that lack X-Request-ID for ~30% of failing requests, so traces aren't joining.

maria (support): customers affected: a handful of PLG accounts in us-west, and one enterprise trial. They’re reporting requests hanging ~10-15s then 504. Need an ETA to share.

tara (oncall): priority list: 1) mitigate customer impact 2) restore observability for debugging 3) long-term fix. I’ll hand primary to ashley for live mitigation and kevin for runtime/root cause.

ashley (eng-sre): immediate stopgaps:
- enable short-term debug logging at gateway for 30m
- bump trace sampling to 5% for /v1/* for next hour
- inject request-id at ingress to ensure linkability
I can flip these quickly.

kevin (eng-runtime): for runtime: look at model-proxy concurrency. If backend qps or batch latencies spiked, we may need to reduce batch size and enable fallback routing to smaller model variant. I’ll check metrics on kv-cache hitrate and model backpressure.

jonah (observability): quick command to increase sampling (we use the sampling config in config-cluster):
```bash
kubectl -n observability patch configmap tracing-sampling -p '{"data":{"prod_sampling":"0.05"}}'
```
This will take ~30s to roll out to agents.

ashley (eng-sre): injecting request-id at envoy layer now (temp override):
```yaml
# envoy header insertion snippet (temp)
- name: envoy.filters.http.lua
  typed_config:
    "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.http.lua.v3.Lua
    inline_code: |
      function envoy_on_request(request_handle)
        local rid = request_handle:headers():get("x-request-id")
        if not rid then
          request_handle:headers():add("x-request-id", os.time().."-gw")
        end
      end
```
Patching gateway ingress to include this for 15m window, then revert.

ashley (eng-sre): also temporarily lowering gateway upstream keepalive and reducing per-connection concurrency to reduce head-of-line. Patch rolling in now.

kevin (eng-runtime): I see model-proxy pods CPU at 98% and backlog in the request queue. Reducing batch size for model shard pool 3 and spinning up burst nodes. Doing canary change:
```bash
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/model-proxy BATCH_MAX_TOKENS=512 --record
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/model-proxy --replicas=10
```
This should lower tail latency but increase ops cost.

maria (support): please note: customers need a brief status update. Can we confirm % of requests impacted?

jonah (observability): quick metric: about 2.1% of total traffic in us-west is 5xx in last 10m, peak to 4.7% at spike. Most affected paths: /v1/generate (65%), /v1/chat (30%).

tara (oncall): ashley/kevin — once you have a mitigation plan, we’ll craft a short status page blurb and CS note. If mitigation is >15m, we need an incident page.

ashley (eng-sre): debug logging and request-id injection are live. Trace sampling bumped to 5%. I'm seeing additional logs now with X-Request-ID, forwarding to traces ingestion. Initial results: failures trending down in last 3m.

incidents-bot: Deploy event: gateway-ingress patch started by ashley at 17:14 UTC.

kevin (eng-runtime): model-proxy batches reduced and replica bump applied. Backend queue depth decreasing. 504 rate dropped to ~1.2% in last 5m.

jonah (observability): traces now joining; I can see a pattern where a subset of requests from a specific LB node are missing keepalive and show TLS renegotiation errors. Could be a kernel/network socket exhaustion on that node group.

ashley (eng-sre): isolating node group and draining suspicious nodes. Patch to LB to stop routing to those nodes in progress.

maria (support): handing draft status: "We’re investigating timeouts affecting a subset of requests in US-West. Mitigation in progress; retries/backups reducing errors. Updated ETA in 30 minutes." Want approval to send?

tara (oncall): send the message. Include note we’re monitoring and engaging infra teams. :thumbsup:

ashley (eng-sre): draining nodes completed. Post-drain, 5xx stable at 0.8%. I’ll keep request-id injection and sampling for 1 hour then revert.

kevin (eng-runtime): long-term action items logged: investigate socket reuse/keepalive settings on LB nodes, add rate-limited backpressure at gateway for bursty clients, add health-checks for model-proxy queue depth to trigger autoscaling earlier.

jonah (observability): follow-ups: wire request-id enforcement for all clients, increase default trace sampling for gateway to 1% (from 0.5%), and add a trace link in our 5xx alert payload.

tara (oncall): handing to kevin and ashley for postmortem. I’m signing out of primary. If something regresses, re-alert me.

kevin (eng-runtime): taking primary for root-cause and remediation.

ashley (eng-sre): taking ownership of mitigation verification and temporary instrumentation cleanup.

maria (support): I’ve notified affected customers with the status blurb. Will follow up with details if we have a timeline.

jonah (observability): saving traces and logs for postmortem. Snapshotting service map for the spike window.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1959001122 — Elevated gateway 504/5xx spike (us-west). Severity=P2. Owners: kevin, ashley.

tara (oncall): thanks team. Closing handoff. Keep updates to this thread.

ashley (eng-sre): quick note — because traces were missing initially, the request-id injection was the most useful stopgap. Recommend a lightweight enforcement at edge so future incidents aren’t blind.

kevin (eng-runtime): agreed. I’ll add that to the action items and include a rollout plan for request-id enforcement and model-proxy health-triggered autoscaling.

maria (support): closing loop with customers: replies queued, will send postmortem note when available.

jonah (observability): scheduled a post-incident sync at 19:00 UTC to review traces and sampling decisions.

ashley (eng-sre): marking mitigation as successful for now. Will clean up temp configs at 17:45 UTC unless we see regression. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Auto-note: temporary debug logs will expire in 31 minutes (17:45 UTC).

kevin (eng-runtime): logging actions and follow-ups to GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/832 (internal).

tara (oncall): great work. Closing thread but keeping incident open for postmortem action items."
